notes: Extracted 31 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/cardcta.guide.tsx, self-contained) and docs/evidence/cardcta.md at e7ed622 (28 October, on origin/main; the guide and evidence are the same on origin/main and origin/docs-next). The guide's Sources note ("Checked 19 October 2026", "16 October build") and the evidence were checked on 19 October 2026 on 0.1.78-a116616, so items citing the evidence carry 2026-10-19 and 0.1.78-a116616 (same package version, so the trace check flags none); no item cites the Sources note. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-a116616 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (4 commits, 222 files) changes CardCTA.tsx and Badge.tsx among the files the card renders: CardCTA.tsx is 12f3f2b at a116616, c7d3348 and c8526ae, 4b9d8f4 at ace46ca and 037ab56 at dbe0e02, the same blob as node_modules; Badge.tsx (1e060c6 → b091d4d) changed only the label token for Semantic Intent System with Emphasis High (white instead of black on the status fill); Button.tsx (e266c65), IconCapsule.tsx (f4496d2), IconButton.tsx (dd6c456), ButtonGroup.tsx (0a18651), Avatar.tsx (26f5b52), Icon.tsx (cddaa05), Image.tsx (049a31f), react-utils.ts (bd10632), typography.ts (cbabe67), figma-variables-resolver.ts (d03e77c) and JFSThemeProvider.tsx (fa8a86a) are the same blobs, and the compare touches no token or modes file. So the card changed after the guide's check (Biscuit's ace46ca and dbe0e02 for Component Bug #345), as the evidence's 28 October note says ("this guide's copy wasn't re-checked and waits for #345's own publish"). Read in the installed source (CardCTA.tsx) and on the guide page rendered on it (31 October, react-native-web 0.21.2 in headless Chrome, 1280 and 390 px, a private build in the scratch folder): the root is overflow hidden (305); the title clamps to one line and the body to three unless disableTruncation (519–527; the Long copy card's body is cut at three lines, 51 of 102 px, and at 260 px the title ends in …); the default Button gets disableTruncation, so its label stays on one line and ends in … (Button.tsx 431–438), and the 9,999 px measuring copy is gone (the page's scrollWidth equals its width); the Button and its wrapper stretch (386–399), so every default Button fills its column (159.6 px “Set up” on a 320 px cta card, 222 px Save on rating, 298 px on sip; Component Bug #414, In progress, Biscuit) and a long label ends in … inside it; the rating badge defaults to AppearanceBrand Secondary under the caller's modes (285), purple with a white label, and ratingMediaAlign moves it (641–647: centred by default); sip without avatarSource shows a Monogram of the title's initials, or the headline's (568–594: “SA” in the guide's Don't), not a stock photo; with MediaBlock Image the right column has no padding and 12 px right corners and clips (286–297, 362–374), so a picture in iconSlot is clipped to the card's corners; new props badge and caption on cta (45–56, 528–531), disableTruncation, likeAccessibilityLabel, dislikeAccessibilityLabel, iconAccessibilityLabel and avatarAccessibilityLabel (the default IconCapsule and Avatar are decorative unless named, 68–72, 552–603), and ...rest with accessibilityLabel (a labelled root is a group on the web, 532–540). So these guide sentences no longer hold and are left out (human flag in reviews/cardcta.json, pointing at #345): Anatomy's Title note “nothing cuts it short” (the part quotes only “title: the offer, 16 px bold”; the Body part quotes only “body: what the step gives, 14 px”, leaving “it wraps”, true only up to three lines); Configuration's “AppearanceBrand changes only the rating badge.” (the new cta badge gets the card's modes, 528, 52) and the AppearanceBrand Secondary caption “The rating badge turns purple, as Figma draws it.” (it is purple without it); Sizing's “Height follows the text: nothing cuts the title or body short, so longer copy or a narrower host makes the card taller.” and “The button grows with its label and never wraps.”, and the Long copy caption; Content's “the card doesn’t cut either short” (the rule quotes only “Keep the title to one line and the body to three”); the Do & Don'ts description and the Don't captions of all three pairs (“runs out of the card”, “A stranger’s photo appears in its place.”, “Its corners poke out past the card’s rounded corners.”); and the Sources sentences on Figma's picture CTA, the unclipped picture, the gold badge, nothing cutting the text short, the long label, ratingMediaAlign, the stock photo and the 9,999 px copy. The Narrow host caption still holds (the body takes three lines at 260 px instead of two) but is left out: at that width the title now ends in …. Token values through the package's own getVariableByName (lib/commonjs): panel white, radius 12, border 1 px, white by default and rgb(235, 235, 237) with Page type SubPage or context 8 Section; left padding 12/8, 22 top and bottom, gap 16; text gap 6; title 16 px, line 18 (rendered 20 through safeTextLineHeight), 700, rgb(12, 13, 16); body 14/17, 400, rgb(19, 0, 45); Button AppearanceBrand Secondary, Button / Size S (rgb(93, 0, 181), white label, 32 px), Emphasis Medium rgb(228, 219, 255) with a purple label, Emphasis Low transparent, Semantic Intent System positive rgb(38, 171, 33) and warning rgb(240, 110, 15); IconCapsule Size M 42 px, Emphasis Medium, AppearanceBrand Secondary (rgb(228, 219, 255), purple icon), 58 px with Context CTACard, warning rgb(240, 110, 15) with a white icon; rating badge Secondary rgb(93, 0, 181), Primary rgb(206, 161, 90), Neutral rgb(48, 51, 56), Tertiary rgb(2, 107, 154); sip Avatar Size L, 42 px. Ticket #345 (Component Fix, In progress, Biscuit), read on the board (read only): its 27 October re-test on dbe0e02 found items 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7 fixed and item 3's picture CTA buildable with badge and caption, and left open: a long badge isn't truncated or held to its column (it runs under the picture, cut mid-word), the chip-to-title gap is 6 px where Figma's is 16, and the caption is 12/16 regular in the body colour where Figma's Text is 14/16 medium black; it filed #414 for the Button filling its column. None of these is in the evidence or the guide, so none can be a gap here: they are in the human flag. Gaps: the two evidence discrepancies that still hold on dbe0e02 (rendered title line 20 px, like and dislike 26 px); the evidence's rating and sip heights were measured with Figma's copy and are not carried. Strength: no rule is required: no prop is required in the facts and no quoted absolute applies everywhere; the defaults back recommended “Set …” rules. The quoted absolutes are Configuration's “always purple at size S” and States' “only respond”, both scoped contextual. useWhen/2–3 and the avoidWhen rules rest on the evidence's record of Biscuit's handwritten mdx; read through gh api, the mdx at upstream dbe0e02f still says “a prompt with one next step. It does not complete the action. The button does.”, sends a status message to CardFeedback and a bank or product summary to CardBankAccount or CardProviderInfo, and warns against a second primary button. Facts: FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES give Button / Size its collection default M, which the card overrides for its own Button (273), so an evidence fact sets S; evidence facts also say the card keeps its Button and IconCapsule at AppearanceBrand Secondary and the capsule at Emphasis Medium (273, 357); buttonLabel's default “Button” (“Save” on rating, 283) is the evidence's, as the type facts carry no default for it. Fact-based items for the installed props the guide doesn't cover: badge, caption, disableTruncation, ratingMediaAlign, type's Figma names, and the four accessibility labels. Do & Don'ts: only the first pair is kept, with its Do caption as the why; the second pair's Do caption backs a configuration rule. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode (the guide sets Light on every card, the VStack and the Title), no Slot gap M on the VStack, no style width 320 (the guide's frame), no modes. Copy is the guide's own (COPY, guide lines 14–18, and the In context Title, 118); the sip logo is a docs asset (jio-gold-logo.png), so the example passes a { uri }. VStack has an entry; Title has an undocumented entry. Left out of examples (three at most): the anatomy and sizing specimens, Slots, the mode cards (building rules keep modes at their defaults; their captions are kept as rules), the States cards, Long copy, Narrow host (it sets a style width), the Do & Don'ts and the playground. Not recorded: style (hosting; the building rules forbid colour, border, radius and font overrides); MediaBlock (only the Don't uses it, and its caption no longer holds), Context Nudge&Alert and ListItem, Button / State, Badge Size, Avatar Size, Icon Capsule Size, Color Mode, context 9, context 10, Context2, Context4 and Profile Card Appearance; ratingBadgeSlot, ratingActionsSlot and avatarSlot beyond the slots rule (the evidence's Limits); accessibilityLabel and testID (inherited View props, not part of the design contract); the evidence's hex values, web render tree and Hosting; the Sources' Storybook sentence. Consistency with related entries: Button's entry (Button / Size S for an action inside a card) agrees with the card's small Button. IconCapsule's entry (Emphasis Medium a pale circle with a coloured icon; Semantic Intent System colours it with AppearanceSystem and ignores Emphasis; Context CTACard 58 px; the capsule hides its icon from screen readers) agrees: the card's capsule is Emphasis Medium, warning turns it orange, CTACard gives 58 px, and the card names it only through iconAccessibilityLabel. Card's entry (Page type SubPage and context 8 Section give a grey border) agrees. Title and VStack are used as their entries allow. No other guidance file names Card CTA: the cardfinancialcondition and iconcapsule entries mention only the Context CTACard mode. Shape words: nothing hand-written here uses one Coin doesn't have, and neither the guide, the evidence, CardCTA.tsx nor the upstream mdx at dbe0e02f does; Button.tsx's own comments do (lines 25–27 and 127), which #544 already lists. Cross-check: two rounds. Round 1 flagged placementAdvice/0 as generalising the Home screen example (now worded as the guide's Home screen) and noted that avoidWhen/3's “the card has one button” overlooks like and dislike (now “don’t add one”). Round 2 flagged configuration/10 (disableTruncation) and configuration/21 (ratingMediaAlign), items that rest on the installed package's facts, read against the a116616 guide and evidence: dismissed in reviews/cardcta.json, as for ProductMerchandisingCard's #356 items. Both rounds noted that the badge, caption and accessibility-label items rest on dbe0e02 facts the a116616 guide contradicts; that is the human flag. Round 2 also noted that content.good carries the rating example's copy (Your credit score rose, Save), which the guide shows outside Content.
